parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: A reference to the MQTT Client used by this Bulk Data Collection Profile when communicating via the MQTT Protocol.

parameters.name: PublishTopic
parameters.description: The topic name the Agent MUST use when sending the Bulk Data report.

parameters.name: PublishQoS
parameters.description: The Agent MUST use this QoS value when sending the Bulk Data report. If the referenced MQTT Client uses MQTT 5.0 and the MQTT server only indicates support for a QoS value in the CONNACK Maximum QoS property lower than this QoS value, the Agent MUST use the highest QoS value that is supported by the server.

parameters.name: PublishRetain
parameters.description: If set to {{true}} the Agent MUST set the RETAIN flag in MQTT PUBLISH messages carrying the Bulk Data report to 1, unless the MQTT server sent Retain Available = 0 (MQTT 5.0) in its CONNACK (in which case, the Agent MUST set the RETAIN flag to 0).

object.description: This object defines the properties to be used when transporting bulk data using the MQTT protocol. This object is used when the {{param|#.Protocol}} parameter has a value of {{enum|MQTT|##.Protocols}}.
